lighting_shading.note: Soft, even lighting with gentle highlights on sails and hull.

value_contrast.note: Clear separation via value difference between ship and background.

color_palette.note: Warm wood tones contrast with cool blue water and purple sky.

composition_hierarchy.note: Ship is the sole focus, centered and large in frame.

shape_proportions.note: Chunky, toy-like proportions with a very clear, readable silhouette.

viewpoint_depth.note: Simple three-quarter view with minimal perspective depth.

edges_linework.note: Clean edges defined by color contrast rather than dark outlines.

surface_finish.note: Smooth, stylized surfaces with soft gradients, no realistic texture.

pose_rhythm.note: Static pose with calm energy; repeated sails create rhythm.
